description_en: Queries a standard or common parameter and its value
description_zh: 获取一个普通参数或公共参数，包括参数值
kebab_example: aliyun oos get-parameter --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --name MyParameter --parameter-version 1 --resource-group-id rg-acfmxsn4m00000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetParameter

parameters.help_en: The name of the parameter. The name can be up to 200 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (\_)
parameters.help_zh: 参数名称。取值范围：内容限制为字母、数字、中划线、下划线，长度不能超过200字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The version number of the parameter. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.name: parameter_version

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id
